name: Box Wipe Lower Third
description: A line sweeps in, a see-through box wipes open and an underlined script title and subtitle fade in; it wipes shut before Duration.

controls.name: Title
controls.description: Wraps onto two lines when wider than Max Width.

controls.name: Subtitle
controls.description: Smaller second line; leave empty for none (the box closes up).

controls.name: Position
controls.description: The box's bottom-left corner, in frame pixels (9x16: [70, 1640]).

controls.name: Max Width
controls.description: Widest the box may be before the title wraps, in pixels (9x16: 900).

controls.name: Box Opacity
controls.description: How see-through the box is, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Line Colour
controls.description: The line along the top and the underline.

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds; it wipes shut over its last 0.7 s.
